explication: Super Productivity is a cross-platform task-management application combining projects, tags, scheduling, timeboxing, time tracking, integrations, and synchronization. The principal workflow is: a user opens the routed client, organizes tasks, schedules or focuses on work, and receives persisted or synchronized results. Sampled code confirms routing, drag-based planning, local persistence, theme storage, Android focus mode, widgets, and SuperSync quota handling. Many feature implementations were not sampled, so those branches use documented capabilities and enclosing source directories without asserting finer call relationships.
